blocking_note: Neither labeler is a human. The r15 requirement (two independent human labelers, unanimous rows only) is met in form by two independent model labelers and is not met in substance until the captain accepts model labelers or a human relabels the gating rows. Until then the set gates the deterministic half in tests and the judge through a recorded cassette (arctic-qa calibrate-standalone).
held_out: Rows with slice 'held_out' are chapter 2 candidates that the yield audit judged. They are never used to iterate the prompt text; they measure a prompt revision after it is written. Rows with slice 'core' are the r15 rows. Rows with slice 'seen' were held-out rows until the chapter 3 production run: the v4 judge passed them, and the v5 prompt was revised on them, so they no longer measure a revision. Their labels are unchanged.
labelers: r15-holistic-audit-r1 verdicts with one reviewing labeler (claude-opus-5)
labeling_rule: Every row carries two labelers as fields. A row gates only when both labelers agree; a disputed row keeps label 'disputed', is recorded for the audit trail, and is never recorded in a cassette or scored.
north_star: Can a strong scientist who cannot see the paper state what the task asks for, name the kind of answer it wants, and resolve every referent from the displayed text alone? The scientist is not expected to know the measured value.
release_rule: No must_fail row may pass the composed gate decision, and at least 80 percent of must_pass rows must pass it, evaluated on a cassette recorded against the current STANDALONE_SYSTEM text (arctic-qa calibrate-standalone --mode replay).
